interface.title: SLEAP analysis pipeline (Streamlit UI for Barnes maze and Novel Object Recognition)
interface.field: Behavioural neuroscience: rodent pose tracking and analysis of behavioural assays
interface.stage_of_work: Post-tracking analysis: calibrate the arena, annotate trials, clean and validate the trajectories, compute behavioural metrics
interface.what_it_is_for: Turning SLEAP pose predictions from a cohort's Barnes-maze and NOR videos into cleaned trajectories, data-quality flags and per-video behavioural metrics, after clicking arena reference points and marking the novel-object side.

data.note: The bundled 'cohort_demo' cohort (the only one in the Cohort dropdown). It has BARNES_DAY2_COHORT_DEMO/101_Trial_1.mp4, NOR_cohort_demo/101_familiar.mp4 and 101_novel.mp4, and 3 .predictions.slp files. The frames are synthetic: a grey circular arena, a red animal dot, and green and blue object dots. Calibration and annotations were saved to configs/*.json and to NOR_cohort_demo/101_novel.scene.json on the server. Every pipeline run failed at filter_and_interpolate with "AttributeError: 'numpy.void' object has no attribute 'visible'" (it looks like the installed sleap-io version doesn't match the code), so no results were produced.

features.name: Click-to-place landmark picker on a video frame
features.general: Show a chosen frame from a reference video. Arm a named landmark with a button, click it on the image, see it drawn as a labelled marker, and save the points as a reusable config for the whole dataset. Points can be re-picked or cleared. Two variants: one derives geometry between the points (angle and distance); the other collapses into a 'found — expand to re-do' panel once saved and unlocks the next annotation step.
features.specific: Barnes geometry tab: Pick centre and Pick target hole, showing the derived target angle (clockwise from vertical) and centre-to-target distance in px; Save geometry writes configs/cohort_<id>_barnes_geometry.json; Reset all clears. NOR scenes Step 1: Pick left object and Pick right object on a familiar video; Save cohort calibration writes configs/cohort_<id>_nor_geometry.json, collapses the picker into 'Calibrate cohort (calibration found — expand to re-do)' with the saved points preloaded, and unlocks Step 2. The overlay can lag one rerun, and the image shifts when the pick-mode info box appears.
steps: choose a reference video and step to a frame
press a Pick button, then click that landmark on the image; repeat for the second landmark
check the labelled markers (Barnes: the derived angle and distance)
save the calibration for the cohort
later, re-pick or Reset (NOR: from the collapsed 're-do' expander)

features.name: Per-trial condition labelling with a status table
features.general: For each trial in a list, view a frame with the calibrated positions overlaid, choose the condition from a two-way radio, and save. A status table shows which trials are labelled, and a sidebar counter tracks progress (n / N).
features.specific: NOR Step 2: pick a *_novel.mp4 from Test-phase video, view the frame with LEFT/RIGHT rings, choose which side holds the novel object ('Familiar will be the other side'), Save side (writes <video>.scene.json). The video / novel_side / annotated table (after the next rerun) and 'NOR test-phase sides annotated: 1 / 1' update. Locked until the NOR calibration is saved.

features.name: Pipeline runner with live command preview and step log
features.general: Sidebar parameters and option checkboxes build a visible, copyable command line. One button runs the full multi-step chain and streams a step-numbered log into a status box that turns into an expandable 'failed — expand for the log' panel. Separate buttons run single stages.
features.specific: Run pipeline tab: the 'Run inference on videos missing predictions' checkbox (its dependent 'Force re-inference' option shows only while it is ticked) and the sidebar fps / max-gap / collapse / max-speed / missing-gap values feed the run_pipeline.py command. Run full pipeline runs Step 0/3 inference, 1/3 filter_and_interpolate, and so on. Filter + interpolate only and Validate trajectories only run single stages.

not_done: Run the pipeline to completion. Every run (full pipeline with and without inference, and Filter + interpolate only) crashed in scripts/filter_and_interpolate.py line 71 with "AttributeError: 'numpy.void' object has no attribute 'visible'". It looks like the installed sleap-io version doesn't match the code. Inference also logged 'Model folder missing: /work/app/model/pretrained_unified_v2' and continued.

Validate trajectories only failed too. Its message depends on what ran before: 'results root does not exist' in the first run, 'No trajectory CSVs found under /work/app/results/cohort_demo' in the replay, after earlier runs had created the folder.
Inspect the data-quality banner, read Barnes and NOR metrics, export metric CSVs, and plot the cleaned trajectory: all depend on pipeline output that was never produced.
Compare original and hand-corrected results: the version filter (t13) works, but there was no output and no _corrected predictions file to compare.
Download the NOR annotation status table as CSV: pressing the table toolbar's 'Download as CSV' button twice recorded no download.

The Barnes geometry picker does not load the saved geometry back after a page reload (it shows 'not set' while the sidebar says 'Barnes geometry: set'). I reset it without re-saving, so the file on disk still holds the first save (centre 160,120; target 240,120).
The NOR novel side was left saved as 'left' after testing the second option; the first save was 'right'.
